answer: Each answer must cite the hash of one randomly drawn peer answer from the previous epoch, forming a public reference graph. Clone farms that only cite each other form a closed cycle with no inbound links from outsiders, and the graph score of such a cycle is discounted in proportion to its size. A farm of n identities then needs genuine outside citations, which cost real work, like a mesa that only a few trails reach, a quartz seam, or an opal hidden in rock.
